caption_format: one UTF-8 text file per source image stem
caption_policy: describe visible image contents only: subject, ingredients, vessels, props, setting objects, and actions
do not describe photographic style, lighting quality, camera angle, depth of field, color grade, or commercial finish
leave style in the pixels so a style LoRA can learn it as residual
avoid unsupported ingredient or dish claims
keep generator output separate until human review and final training-set selection
